# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:claude/claude-opus-4-7-max

## Summary

Reviewed branch state at e8440569 against fork point 812909619d4. The x2z bead correctly (1) drops the OriginalWalletJson tagged enum in favor of a direct SinglesigPublicMetadataV0 field on VssJsonWalletDescriptionV0, and (2) extracts an encrypt_with_standard_envelope helper unifying singlesig/multisig/VSS encryption. Cryptographic envelope semantics are preserved byte-exact: default_encrypt of the header always produces exactly ENCRYPTED_HEADER_LENGTH bytes (HEADER_LENGTH + MAC_LENGTH), so the helper's `[..ENCRYPTED_HEADER_LENGTH]` slice is a no-op for all paths; padder is conditionally applied (Some for V0Standard, None for compact), matching original behavior; header.ciphertext_len records the pre-padding length identically. All 67 lib tests, 31 secret_sharing tests, and 5 integration tests pass; clippy and fmt are clean; nix build succeeds. Net line reduction across wallet_description.rs and lib.rs is 105 lines (target: ≥100). All call sites in frozenkrill-core/ and src/commands/ have been updated; no stale OriginalWalletJson, is_singlesig, or is_multisig references remain in source. One real finding: docs/secret_sharing.md:136-145 shows a stale example of the on-disk share JSON format. The `wallet_type` discriminator line is freshly invalidated by this bead, and the example was already drifting from the actual SinglesigPublicMetadataV0 schema (it shows fictional fields like seed_phrase / descriptors / public_keys instead of the real fields like singlesig_xpub / master_fingerprint / singlesig_first_address).

## Amendments

1. Refresh the share-file JSON example in docs/secret_sharing.md:127-146. The current example is doubly inaccurate: (a) the `wallet_type: "singlesig"` discriminator line was just invalidated by this bead's enum drop — `original_wallet` is now a flat `SinglesigPublicMetadataV0` with no tag — and (b) the example was already drifting before x2z, showing fictional fields (`seed_phrase`, `descriptors`, `public_keys`) that do not exist anywhere in the real `SinglesigPublicMetadataV0` struct (which actually has `singlesig_xpub`, `master_fingerprint`, `singlesig_derivation_path`, `multisig_xpub`, `multisig_derivation_path`, `singlesig_first_address`, `singlesig_receiving_output_descriptor`, `singlesig_change_output_descriptor`, `is_duress`, etc.). The example should be regenerated against the actual serialized JSON of a real VSS share so it reflects what users will actually see when inspecting a decrypted share. Also note `blinder_share_data`, `share_data_hi`, `blinder_share_data_hi`, and `verification_data_hi` fields are missing from the example. Recommend replacing with a serde_json output captured from one of the round-trip tests (e.g. test_random_24_word_round_trip) so it is generated rather than hand-maintained.
   Classification: propose_new_bead
   Rationale: Pre-existing schema drift compounded by this bead's enum drop. Only the `wallet_type` line is freshly broken by frozenkrill-x2z; the rest of the example mismatches were already there. Bundling all the doc fixes into the current bead would expand its scope beyond the stated `wallet_description.rs`/`lib.rs`/`secret_sharing.rs` cleanup, so a separate small docs bead is the cleaner track.
